import json, re, random, chess, time, sys
R = json.load(open('/tmp/obench-cell-doh95cuh/bench_opencode_regex-chess_y449y763/re.json'))
def run(fen):
    for p, r in R: fen = re.sub(p, r, fen)
    return fen.split("\n")
def ref(fen):
    b = chess.Board(fen); s = set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN: continue
        c = b.copy(); c.push(m); s.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return s
ex = "<REDACTED_B64> w kq - 0 1"
print(run(ex))
random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0)
n=0; t=time.time(); bad=0
for g in range(300):
    b = chess.Board()
    for ply in range(random.randint(1,200)):
        ms = list(b.legal_moves)
        if not ms: break
        # bias to promotions/castling/ep
        sp = [m for m in ms if m.promotion or b.is_castling(m) or b.is_en_passant(m)]
        b.push(random.choice(sp) if sp and random.random()<0.5 else random.choice(ms))
        if b.turn == chess.WHITE and not b.is_game_over():
            fen = b.fen(en_passant='fen') if random.random()<0.5 else b.fen()
            ours = [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in run(fen)]
            r = ref(fen); n+=1
            ok = len(ours)==len(r) and all(x in r or x.rpartition(" ")[0]+" -" in r for x in ours)
            if not ok:
                bad+=1
                if bad<4: print("FAIL", fen, set(ours)^r)
print(n, "positions", bad, "bad", time.time()-t)
EOF
python3 /tmp/rgen/test.py
